# README banner

[Project overview](../../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

The animated banner at the top of the project overview, in a light and a dark version.

The overview shows the version that matches the reader's GitHub theme through a `<picture>` element. Both files are generated by the shared banner tool (`tools/hero/heroes.py` in the public [mvalancy/mvalancy](https://github.com/mvalancy/mvalancy/tree/main/tools/hero) repository) from this project's two-port KiCad layout; each SVG's `<desc>` records the source commit. Do not edit them by hand: regenerate with `heroes.py pcb-agx-thor-can-breakout --repo mvalancy/pcb-agx-thor-can-breakout=<checkout>` and confirm with `--check`.

The banners use CSS animation only (no script or SMIL), replay on a loop (build, hold the finished frame, fade, build again), hold still on the final frame under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and are decorative: they are not design evidence.
